title: ISO 8573-2:2018 — Compressed air — Contaminant measurement — Part 2: Oil aerosol content
locator: Official abstract: sampling and quantitative analysis of liquid oil and oil aerosols in compressed air; oil vapour is excluded and addressed by ISO 8573-5.
notes: Oil aerosol measurement method only; do not treat it as oil-vapour measurement or total-oil measurement without the applicable complementary method and sampling plan.
